networks.name: yabloko_site_guide
networks.description: Answers questions about Yabloko Labs — what the company does, the AI agents and hybrid quantum-AI products it builds, its open-source MCP servers, how to engage it, and how to apply to its open roles — from the site's published pages only.
sample_queries: What does Yabloko Labs actually do, and where is it based?
Which AI agent and quantum-AI products does Yabloko Labs offer, and how do I start a project?
Which MCP servers has Yabloko Labs published, and what does each one do?
Which roles are open right now, and where do I send an application?

llm_router.note: No publisher-funded inference endpoint is offered. The network is published as data; a caller site's runtime executes it with the caller's own router, model policy, and credential.

peer_policy.note: The published network answers from the text bundled in its own definition. It contacts no other origin, so no peer or MCP origin is permitted.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle on GitHub Pages; a public MCP facade requires an application host.

deployment.note: Data-only publication. yablokolabs.com hosts no browser agent runtime; a caller site's runtime loads the definition and runs it locally.
